lesson_text: Uncertainty-conditioned selection (mu_hat/sigma_hat from NGBoost Normal predictive dist over 14 aligned-Z KR factors) is NOT a lever for the KR long-only IC->PORT_t transfer wall. On a genuinely known-good base (rank-IC t=6.30 full / 4.87 post2017), sigma_hat conditioning WORKS mechanically (Arm B selected mean sigma 0.109 < Arm A 0.127 < universe 0.118) but produced ZERO realized PORT_t improvement: top-25 EW long-only canonical PORT_t(NW lag-3) = ArmA 0.196/ArmB 0.008 (full) and ArmA -1.377/ArmB -1.155 (post2017); paired NW-t of the B-A active diff = -0.42 (full) / +0.45 (post2017), both insignificant with opposite signs. The binding wall is REAL top-region decay + short-side-carried IC, NOT selection-into-noise: full-universe rank-IC t=3.38 but top-half (long-only-relevant) rank-IC t=1.89 (insignificant), and GROSS (pre-cost) top-25 active t=0.66 -> no long edge before costs even matter. Robust to base choice: raw EW composite (t=6.30) directly measured hits the SAME wall (ArmA -0.87/-1.83). Generalizes measurement-graduation section6 'IC != PORT_t' / 'orthogonal != profit' to the UNCERTAINTY-CONDITIONING axis: sigma_hat is not the axis where the KR long-only signal dies. screen_route=NONE (net_sharpe 0.48<0.7 fails screening gate; not even OVERLAY_CANDIDATE since there is no residual long edge to overlay). No capital path. Honest negative (AX-000).
mechanism_hypothesis: Down-weighting high-forecast-uncertainty (high sigma_hat) names should improve IC->PORT_t transfer by avoiding noisy top-region picks. FALSIFIED: mechanism fires (low-sigma tilt achieved) but realized long-only alpha unchanged because the KR IC is carried by the un-harvestable short side, not by top-region ordering.
